recent.text: Alex Laferriere got back to the "old stomping grounds" as the @LAKings hit the ice at Harvard for today's practice. More on a full-circle moment for 1⃣4⃣+ today's alignment, the latest on Erik Gustafsson and the approach heading into a four-game trip 👇 https://t.co/JuTos969RP
recent.author: Zach Dooley

recent.text: On November 16, 2019, Jeff Carter appeared in his 1,000th career NHL game, and his 500th game with the @LAKings. Nikolai Prokhorkin scored his first career goal, and Jeff Carter scored his 371st career goal in a 4-3 win versus the Vegas Golden Knights. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/s0QPVgRyf1
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 16, 2018, rookie @LAKings goaltender Cal Petersen earned his first career win in his first NHL start. Petersen made 34 saves, and Ilya Kovalchuk and Anze Kopitar scored in a shootout in a 2-1 win over the Chicago Blackhawks. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/9kr9cJPCEs
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 16, 1995, Wayne Gretzky recorded six points in a 9-2 win versus the New York Islanders. Jamie Storr made 34 saves, and @LAKings forward Vitali Yachmenev scored two goals to lead all NHL rookies in scoring with 10 goals and 20 points in 19 games. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/RU8g1i3MsE
recent.author: The Kingstorian

recent.text: On November 16, 1991, @LAKings head coach Tom Webster was ejected for throwing a stick at referee Kerry Fraser in a game against the Red Wings. The stick-throwing incident earned Webster the longest suspension by an NHL coach (12 games), and a $10,000 fine. #LAKings #GoKingsGo https://t.co/0zutgWND4R
